lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after adoption (sign_in, reorder) yielded a win (+7.0%), though a second attempt showed no clear effect.
Introducing a new flow on home (home, new_flow) and quality guidance hints for adoption (adoption, hint) were helpful (+8.6% and +5.4%).
Streamlining path selection copy (choose_path, copy) hurt performance (-4.7%).
Layout updates, background notifications, tutorial screens, incentives, copy changes, and general hints showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too optimistic, overestimating gains for most tests.
Predictions were too low for the winning home new flow (+1.0% predicted vs +8.6% measured).

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in after adoption was helpful in one test (+7.0%), though a second attempt showed no clear effect.
Introducing a new flow on home (+8.6%) and specific hints for adoption (+5.4%) and path decisions (+3.1%) were helpful.
Streamlining path selection copy hurt performance (-4.7%), and sign-in restore hints also hurt performance (-5.8%).
Layout updates, background notifications, wait info, tutorial screens, incentives, and other copy changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too optimistic, overestimating expected gains for most tests.
Predictions were too low for the winning home new flow (+1.0% predicted vs +8.6% measured) and path decision hint (+0.5% predicted vs +3.1% measured).
